description: Engage another Sim with a friendly interaction (greeting, hug, compliment, or similar — whichever variant the target's pie-menu currently offers). Prerequisite: target Sim is within pie-menu range and exposes a friendly-family entry (target must be known to our local VM; the interaction must currently pass the TTAB 'check' tree — e.g. not busy refusing, not sleeping, not in incompatible state). Effect: queues the resolved interaction on your action queue; the animated interaction runs against the target and on success nudges your mutual friendship/relationship axis upward (exact deltas are TTAB-driven; observable in nearby_sims.relationship and recent_events as interaction_start/end). Cost: interaction takes in-sim minutes and consumes a slot in your action queue; server refuses if the queue is full or the target is locked.

args.name: target_sim_id
args.description: Persist ID of the target Sim. Preferred — stable across ObjectID re-shuffles.

args.name: target_object_id
args.description: Local ObjectID of the target Sim (short). Accepted when persist ID is unknown.

call_signatures: cf $CF be-friendly --target_sim_id <nearby_sims[].persist_id>                       # preferred — use nearby_sims persist_id
cf $CF be-friendly --target_object_id <nearby_sims[].object_id>                     # alternate — pass the Sim's VMAvatar ObjectID (rare)
common_mistakes: Directed socials (be-friendly/flirt/tell-joke/be-mean/give-gift) resolve target pie-menu by ALIAS substring; if the target's pie menu has no matching entry the handler returns ok=false with the list of available names — read the error to pick a different verb.
Passing --target_object_id for a non-avatar object silently fails these socials (they require VMAvatar target).
Speak rejects leading '/' — that prefix is reserved for admin chat commands; use admin-chat-command instead.
perception_hints: Target's current action (to judge if they're busy): perception.nearby_sims[].current_action
Your social motive (why this matters): perception.motives.social.value
refuse_conditions: no target_sim_id and no target_object_id → ok:false with 'requires target_sim_id or target_object_id'
target_object_id not a Sim (VMAvatar) → ok:false with 'object <id> is not a Sim'
no matching pie-menu entry for verb aliases → ok:false with the list of available interaction names
